title: 22  Vega
text:
22.21 Tree Diagrams (Vega)

22.21.1 Tree layout
The Flare class hierarchy as a node-link tree - plot/tree: the tidy layout (nodes by depth, the root on the left), light diagonal links, nodes coloured by depth, every node named. The image is 1000 x 1600 - over the book’s usual 800 px, as the original’s 1600 px canvas, so the 220 leaf names don’t overlap.
Source: Vega - Tree layout. Data: Flare package and class hierarchy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(def flare (nu/dataset :flare-vega))


(def flare-tree (tree/from-parents flare {:id :id :parent :parent :name :name}))


(plot/render-image
 (plot/tree flare-tree {:mapping {:color #(str (:depth %))}})
 {:width 1000 :height 1600})






22.21.2 Radial tree layout
The same tree around a circle - depth as the radius, links curving along it, every leaf named (group names left out); 1200 x 1200, over the usual size, for the leaf names.
Source: Vega - Radial tree layout. Data: Flare package and class hierarchy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(plot/render-image
 (plot/tree flare-tree {:circular true :mapping {:color #(str (:depth %))}})
 {:width 1200 :height 1200})






22.21.3 Treemap
The Flare classes as nested rectangles, areas by code size (levels below the root as the hierarchy).
Source: Vega - Treemap. Data: Flare package and class hierarchy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(def flare-leaves
  "Flare classes (rows with a size) with `:path` - the names from below the root down to the class."
  (let [by-id (into {} (map (juxt :id identity) flare))
        path-of (fn [row] (->> (iterate (comp by-id :parent) row) (take-while some?) (map :name) reverse rest vec))]
    (mapv #(assoc % :path (path-of %)) (filter :size flare))))


(def flare-levels
  "Hierarchy accessors of `flare-leaves`: one per path level."
  (mapv (fn [i] #(get (:path %) i)) (range (reduce max (map (comp count :path) flare-leaves)))))


(plot/render-image
 {:data flare-leaves :mapping {:value :size :hierarchy flare-levels}
  :charts [(chart/treemap {:padding 1})]}
 {:width 1000 :height 700})






22.21.4 Circle packing
The same hierarchy as nested circles.
Source: Vega - Circle packing. Data: Flare package and class hierarchy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(plot/render-image
 {:data flare-leaves :mapping {:value :size :hierarchy flare-levels}
  :charts [(chart/pack {:padding 2})]}
 {:width 800 :height 800})






22.21.5 Sunburst
The same hierarchy as rings around the root (a partition in polar coordinates).
Source: Vega - Sunburst. Data: Flare package and class hierarchy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(plot/render-image
 {:data flare-leaves :mapping {:value :size :hierarchy flare-levels}
  :coord {:kind :polar}
  :charts [(chart/partition {:root true :leaf-labels false})]}
 {:width 800 :height 800})

title: 22  Vega
text:
22.22 Network Diagrams (Vega)

22.22.1 Edge bundling
Dependencies between Flare classes routed along the class tree (hierarchical edge bundling), coloured by the source’s top-level package.
Source: Vega - Edge bundling. Data: Flare class dependency network, vega-datasets 3.3.1 flare-dependencies.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/flare-dependencies.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(plot/render-image
 (plot/bundle (nu/dataset :flare-dependencies-vega) flare-tree {:from :source :to :target :scales {:color {:legend false}}})
 {:width 900 :height 900})






22.22.2 Force directed layout
Les Misérables characters linked by co-occurrence, laid out by forces (seeded), coloured by group, edge widths by the number of shared chapters.
Source: Vega - Force directed layout. Data: Les Misérables character coappearance network, vega-datasets 3.3.1 miserables.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/miserables.json); original: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase: A Platform for Combinatorial Computing, Addison-Wesley, Reading, MA (1993).; licence: notspecified (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(def miserables-nodes (map #(update % :group str) (nu/dataset :miserables-nodes)))


(def miserables-links (nu/dataset :miserables-links-vega))


(plot/render-image
 (plot/network miserables-links {:from :source :to :target :nodes miserables-nodes :id :index :rng (r/rng :mersenne 7)
                                 :mapping {:color :group} :edge-mapping {:size :value}
                                 :scales {:size {:range [0.5 4] :legend false} :color {:legend false}}})
 {:width 800 :height 700})






22.22.3 Reorderable matrix
The co-occurrence matrix of the characters ordered by group: a cell per pair of characters who meet, coloured by their group when both share it (grey across groups), every name on the axes (x labels vertical) - the original reorders by dragging.
Source: Vega - Reorderable matrix. Data: Les Misérables character coappearance network, vega-datasets 3.3.1 miserables.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/miserables.json); original: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase: A Platform for Combinatorial Computing, Addison-Wesley, Reading, MA (1993).; licence: notspecified (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(let [by-index (into {} (map (juxt :index identity) miserables-nodes))
      order (mapv :name (sort-by (juxt #(parse-long (:group %)) :index) miserables-nodes))]
  (plot/render-image
   {:data (for [{:keys [source target]} miserables-links
                :let [s (by-index source) t (by-index target)]
                [a b] [[s t] [t s]]]
            {:x (:name a) :y (:name b) :group (if (= (:group a) (:group b)) (:group a) "across")})
    :mapping {:x :x :y :y :color :group}
    :charts [(chart/tile)]
    :scales {:x {:domain order} :y {:domain order :reverse true}
             :color {:domain (conj (vec (sort-by parse-long (distinct (map :group miserables-nodes)))) "across")
                     :range (conj (vec (take 11 (cycle (c/palette :category10)))) [190 190 190]) :legend false}}
    :theme {:text {:tick-label {:size 8}} :axis {:x {:label-rotation -90}}}
    :labels {:x nil :y nil}}
   {:width 1000 :height 1000}))






22.22.4 Arc diagram
The same co-occurrences as arcs above the characters, ordered by group, the names reading upward (:labels :name, x labels at -90°).
Source: Vega - Arc diagram. Data: Les Misérables character coappearance network, vega-datasets 3.3.1 miserables.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/miserables.json); original: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase: A Platform for Combinatorial Computing, Addison-Wesley, Reading, MA (1993).; licence: notspecified (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(plot/render-image
 (plot/arc miserables-links {:from :source :to :target :nodes miserables-nodes :id :index
                             :order (mapv :index (sort-by (juxt #(parse-long (:group %)) :index) miserables-nodes))
                             :mapping {:color :group} :scales {:color {:legend false}} :labels :name
                             :theme {:axis {:x {:label-rotation -90}}}})
 {:width 1000 :height 450})

title: 22  Vega
text:
22.23 Other Chart Types (Vega)

22.23.1 Density heatmaps
Miles per gallon against acceleration as a kernel density raster per origin (each panel its own density).
Source: Vega - Density heatmaps. Data: Car specifications and fuel economy, vega-datasets 3.3.1 cars.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/cars.json); original: StatLib Datasets Archive; licence: notspecified (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(plot/render-image
 {:data (filter #(and (:acceleration %) (:miles-per-gallon %)) cars)
  :mapping {:x :acceleration :y :miles-per-gallon :facet-col :origin}
  :charts [(chart/field)]
  :scales {:color {:range :viridis/viridis}}
  :labels {:x "Acceleration" :y "Miles_per_Gallon"}}
 {:width 1000 :height 350})






22.23.2 Beeswarm plot
Les Misérables characters per group as round clusters: each point at the free spot nearest its group’s position (beeswarm :pack :around; :position :overlay - every group over the whole height). The original simulates forces to the same effect.
Source: Vega - Beeswarm plot. Data: Les Misérables character coappearance network, vega-datasets 3.3.1 miserables.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/miserables.json); original: D. E. Knuth, The Stanford GraphBase: A Platform for Combinatorial Computing, Addison-Wesley, Reading, MA (1993).; licence: notspecified (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(plot/render-image
 {:data (map #(assoc % :g (parse-long (:group %))) miserables-nodes) :mapping {:x :g :color :group}
  :charts [(chart/beeswarm {:size 12 :position :overlay :pack :around})]
  :scales {:x {:ticks (vec (range 11))} :color {:legend false}}
  :labels {:x "group" :y nil}}
 {:width 800 :height 350})






22.23.3 Calendar view
Daily change of the S&P 500 close, 2000-2020, diverging around 0: a row of panels per year, a cell per trading day (week of the year × weekday) - in three images of seven years; months marked at the week of their first day (in 2001; a year’s weeks shift by a day or two).
Source: Vega - Calendar view. Data: S&P 500 daily index values and volume, vega-datasets 3.3.1 sp500-2000.csv (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/sp500-2000.csv); original: Yahoo Finance; licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(def sp500-days
  "Trading days with the close's change from the previous trading day: `:year`, `:week` (Sunday-first weeks of the
  year), `:day` (weekday), `:change`."
  (let [days (map #(update % :date local-date) (nu/dataset :sp500-2000))
        week-fields (java.time.temporal.WeekFields/of java.time.DayOfWeek/SUNDAY 1)]
    (mapv (fn [prev {:keys [^LocalDate date close]}]
            {:year (.getYear date) :week (.get date (.weekOfYear week-fields))
             :day (weekdays (dec (.getValue (.getDayOfWeek date))))
             :change (/ (- (double close) (double (:close prev))) (double (:close prev)))})
          days (rest days))))


(def month-weeks
  "Week of the year (as in `sp500-days`) of every month's first day in 2001 -> the month's name."
  (let [week-fields (java.time.temporal.WeekFields/of java.time.DayOfWeek/SUNDAY 1)]
    (into (sorted-map) (map (fn [mo] [(.get (LocalDate/of 2001 (int mo) 1) (.weekOfYear week-fields)) (month-names (dec mo))])
                            (range 1 13)))))


(def calendar
  "The calendar plot without its data (a year range's days are added per image)."
  {:mapping {:x :week :y :day :color :change :facet-row #(str (:year %))}
   :charts [(chart/tile)]
   :scales {:y {:domain (subvec weekdays 0 5) :reverse true}
            :x {:domain [0.5 53.5] :nice false :ticks (vec (keys month-weeks)) :formatter #(month-weeks (m/round (double %)) "")}
            :color {:range [[197 27 125] [247 247 247] [77 146 33]] :midpoint 0 :domain [-0.06 0.06]
                    :formatter #(format "%.0f%%" (* 100.0 (double %))) :title "change"}}
   :theme {:facet {:gap 8} :text {:tick-label {:size 8}}}
   :labels {:x nil :y nil}})


(plot/render-image (assoc calendar :data (filter #(<= 2000 (long (:year %)) 2006) sp500-days)) {:width 1000 :height 800})





(plot/render-image (assoc calendar :data (filter #(<= 2007 (long (:year %)) 2013) sp500-days)) {:width 1000 :height 800})





(plot/render-image (assoc calendar :data (filter #(<= 2014 (long (:year %)) 2020) sp500-days)) {:width 1000 :height 800})






22.23.4 Packed bubble chart
Sixteen amounts as packed circles (the original packs them by forces).
Source: Vega - Packed bubble chart.

(plot/render-image
 {:data (map (fn [k v] {:category (str k) :amount v}) "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP"
             [0.28 0.55 0.43 0.91 0.81 0.53 0.19 0.87 0.28 0.55 0.43 0.91 0.81 0.53 0.19 0.87])
  :mapping {:value :amount :hierarchy [:category] :color :category}
  :charts [(chart/pack {:padding 3})]
  :legend false}
 {:width 500 :height 500})

title: 22  Vega
text:
22.24 Custom Designs (Vega)

22.24.1 Budget forecasts
Each year’s budget forecast of the surplus / deficit (% of GDP, grey lines) against the actual balance (black).
Source: Vega - Budget forecasts. Data: U.S. federal budget balances and forecasts, vega-datasets 3.3.1 budgets.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/budgets.json); original: Office of Management and Budget; licence: other-pd (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(let [budgets (nu/dataset :budgets)]
  (plot/render-image
   {:data budgets :mapping {:x :forecast-year :y :value :group :budget-year}
    :charts [(chart/rule {:y 0 :color :black})
             (chart/line {:color [170 170 170] :width 1})
             (chart/line {:data (filter #(= (:forecast-year %) (dec (long (:budget-year %)))) budgets) :mapping {:group nil}
                          :color :black :width 3})]
    :scales {:x {:formatter #(str (m/round (double %)))}}
    :labels {:x nil :y "Surplus / deficit (% of GDP)"}}
   {:width 800 :height 400}))






22.24.2 Annual temperature
Seattle’s hourly temperature normals over the year, each hour of the day a row from 6 AM, its area scaled into the row (ribbons from the row’s base) - the Vega design of the data in “Trellis Area Plot Showing Annual Temperatures in Seattle” above, in one panel.
Source: Vega - Annual temperature. Data: Seattle hourly climate normals for 1981–2010, vega-datasets 3.3.1 seattle-weather-hourly-normals.csv (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/seattle-weather-hourly-normals.csv); original: NOAA National Climatic Data Center (NCDC); licence: other-pd (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(let [hours (map #(mod (+ 6 %) 24) (range 24))
      row-of (zipmap hours (range 23 -1 -1))
      rows (for [{:keys [date temperature]} (nu/dataset :seattle-weather-hourly-normals)
                 :let [t (java.time.LocalDateTime/parse date)]]
             {:date (.toLocalDate t) :hour (.getHour t) :temperature temperature})
      [lo hi] ((juxt #(reduce min %) #(reduce max %)) (map :temperature rows))]
  (plot/render-image
   {:data (map (fn [{:keys [hour temperature] :as r}]
                 (let [base (double (row-of hour))]
                   (assoc r :base base :top (+ base (* 0.95 (/ (- (double temperature) lo) (- hi lo)))))))
               rows)
    :mapping {:x :date :group :hour}
    :charts [(chart/ribbon {:mapping {:ymin :base :ymax :top} :color [70 130 180] :stroke-color [40 80 120] :stroke-width 0.5})]
    :scales {:y {:ticks (mapv #(+ 0.5 (double (row-of %))) hours)
                 :formatter (let [label (into {} (map (fn [h] [(+ 0.5 (double (row-of h))) (format "%02d:00" h)]) hours))]
                              #(label (double %) ""))}
             :x {:formatter #(.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "MMM" Locale/ENGLISH) ^TemporalAccessor %)}}
    :labels {:title "Seattle Annual Temperatures" :x nil :y nil}}
   {:width 800 :height 650}))






22.24.3 Flight passengers
Passenger traffic at Seattle-Tacoma airport compared with the same month a year before, October 2019 - April 2020.
Source: Vega - Flight passengers.

(plot/render-image
 {:data (map (fn [[date curr prev]] {:date (LocalDate/parse date) :change (- (/ (double curr) (double prev)) 1.0)})
             [["2019-10-01" 4292562 4044655] ["2019-11-01" 3892767 3817267] ["2019-12-01" 4320042 3937790]
              ["2020-01-01" 3764192 3560276] ["2020-02-01" 3620083 3192656] ["2020-03-01" 1824676 4111729]
              ["2020-04-01" 259153 4033516]])
  :mapping {:x :date :y :change}
  :charts [(chart/rule {:y 0 :color [120 120 120]}) (chart/line {:color [70 130 180] :width 3})
           (chart/scatter {:color [70 130 180] :size 8})]
  :scales {:y {:formatter #(format "%+.0f%%" (* 100.0 (double %)))}
           :x {:formatter #(.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "MMM yyyy" Locale/ENGLISH) ^TemporalAccessor %)}}
  :labels {:title "Passenger Traffic at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, One Year to the Next" :x nil
           :y "change from the prior year"}}
 {:width 800 :height 350})






22.24.4 Timelines
The first five US presidents: their lives (thin) and terms (thick, red), with four events as labelled rules (labels staggered in an empty top row; the original tilts them above the chart).
Source: Vega - Timelines.

(let [day (fn [ms] (.toLocalDate (.atZone (java.time.Instant/ofEpochMilli ms) java.time.ZoneOffset/UTC)))
      people (map (fn [[label born died enter leave]]
                    {:label label :born (day born) :died (day died) :enter (day enter) :leave (day leave)})
                  [["Washington" -7506057600000 -5366196000000 -5701424400000 -5453884800000]
                   ["Adams" -7389766800000 -4528285200000 -5453884800000 -5327740800000]
                   ["Jefferson" -7154586000000 -4528285200000 -5327740800000 -5075280000000]
                   ["Madison" -6904544400000 -4213184400000 -5075280000000 -4822819200000]
                   ["Monroe" -6679904400000 -4370518800000 -4822819200000 -4570358400000]])
      events [["Decl. of Independence" (LocalDate/of 1776 7 4)] ["U.S. Constitution" (LocalDate/of 1789 3 4)]
              ["Louisiana Purchase" (LocalDate/of 1803 4 30)] ["Monroe Doctrine" (LocalDate/of 1823 12 2)]]
      names (mapv :label people)]
  (plot/render-image
   {:data people
    :charts [(chart/rule {:x (mapv second events) :color [136 136 136]})
             (chart/text {:x (mapv second events) :y [[:panel 1.0] [:panel 0.93] [:panel 1.0] [:panel 0.93]]
                          :text (mapv first events) :anchor [:left :top] :offset [3 -2] :size 10})
             (chart/rect {:mapping {:x0 :born :x1 :died :y0 :label :y1 :label} :fill [85 85 119] :band-width 0.08})
             (chart/rect {:mapping {:x0 :enter :x1 :leave :y0 :label :y1 :label} :fill [238 68 68] :band-width 0.25})
             (chart/text {:mapping {:x :born :y :label :label :label} :anchor [:left :bottom] :offset [0 6] :size 10})]
    :scales {:y {:domain (into [" "] names) :reverse true :axis false}}
    :labels {:x nil :y nil}}
   {:width 800 :height 380}))






22.24.5 U district cuisine
Restaurants of Seattle’s University District by latitude (south to north), a density ridge per cuisine coloured by kind, the cross streets as rules. The names follow the original’s (its burgers ridge reads “Pizza” and its pizza ridge “Burgers” - its two lists don’t match there).
Source: Vega - U district cuisine. Data: Restaurant and cafe latitudes in Seattle’s University District, vega-datasets 3.3.1 udistrict.json (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/udistrict.json); licence: none listed - see vega-datasets (cite Vega as the source).

(let [categories ["coffee" "drinks" "bubbletea" "vietnamese" "thai" "chinese" "japanese" "korean" "mideastern" "indian"
                  "burgers" "pizza" "american" "breakfast" "bakeries" "seafood" "hawaiian" "veg" "latin"]
      names ["Coffee" "Pubs, Lounges" "Bubble Tea, Juice" "Vietnamese" "Thai" "Chinese" "Japanese" "Korean"
             "Middle Eastern" "Indian, Pakistani" "Pizza" "Burgers" "American" "Breakfast, Brunch" "Bakeries" "Seafood"
             "Hawaiian" "Vegetarian, Vegan" "Mexican, Latin American"]
      colors ["#7f7f7f" "#7f7f7f" "#7f7f7f" "#1f77b4" "#1f77b4" "#1f77b4" "#1f77b4" "#1f77b4" "#2ca02c" "#2ca02c"
              "#ff7f0e" "#ff7f0e" "#ff7f0e" "#8c564b" "#8c564b" "#e377c2" "#e377c2" "#bcbd22" "#17becf"]
      name-of (zipmap categories names)
      streets [["Boat St." 47.6516] ["40th St." 47.655363] ["42nd St." 47.6584] ["45th St." 47.6614]
               ["50th St." 47.664924] ["55th St." 47.668519]]]
  (plot/render-image
   {:data (keep #(when-let [n (name-of (:key %))] (assoc % :cuisine n)) (nu/dataset :udistrict))
    :mapping {:x :lat :y :cuisine :color :cuisine}
    :charts [(chart/rule {:x (mapv second streets) :color [200 200 200]})
             (chart/text {:x (mapv second streets) :y [:panel 1.0] :text (mapv first streets) :anchor [:center :top]
                          :offset [0 -2] :size 9 :background [236 236 243 200]})
             (chart/density {:bandwidth 0.0005 :fill :color :alpha 0.8 :overlap 2.3})]
    :scales {:y {:domain names :reverse true} :color {:domain names :range (mapv c/to-color colors) :legend false}}
    :labels {:x "latitude" :y nil}}
   {:width 800 :height 800}))






22.24.6 Warming stripes
Global temperature anomaly per year, 1880 onward, as stripes from blue (cold) to red (warm) - E. Hawkins’ design.
Source: Vega - Warming stripes. Data: Global land and ocean temperature anomalies, vega-datasets 3.3.1 global-temp.csv (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@3.3.1/data/global-temp.csv); original: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies; licence: other-pd (vega-datasets datapackage.json).

(plot/render-image
 {:data (nu/dataset :global-temp) :mapping {:x :year :y (constantly "1") :color :temp}
  :charts [(chart/tile)]
  :scales {:y {:axis false}
           :color {:range (mapv c/to-color (reverse ["#67000D" "#A50F15" "#CB181D" "#EF3B2C" "#FB6A4A" "#FC9272" "#FCBBA1"
                                                     "#FEE0D2" "#FFFFFF" "#DEEBF7" "#C6DBEF" "#9ECAE1" "#6BAED6" "#4292C6"
                                                     "#2171B5" "#08519C" "#08306B"]))
                   :title "°C"}
           :x {:formatter #(str (m/round (double %)))}}
  :labels {:title "Global temperature change (1880 onward)" :x nil :y nil}}
 {:width 900 :height 300})
